name: IntentFence Policy Agent
description: Checks live x402 endpoint readiness without paying targets, assesses observed quotes, and preflights declared agent spend policy.

skills.name: Agent payment preflight
skills.description: Evaluate caller-declared payment intent and return safe_to_proceed, needs_review, or denied before the caller invokes its downstream tool. IntentFence does not independently authorize or execute the action.
examples: Check whether a declared 428.20 USD quote is within a declared 500 USD ceiling.

skills.name: Live x402 endpoint readiness
skills.description: Make one bounded credential-free request to a public HTTPS endpoint, block redirects and private-network targets, validate its live x402 challenge, and return a signed receipt without paying the target.
examples: Check whether this endpoint currently returns a canonical Base USDC x402 challenge to an approved payee.

skills.name: Caller-observed x402 quote assessment
skills.description: Validate and sign the exact PAYMENT-REQUIRED quote observed by the caller against a Base USDC ceiling, explicit payee allowlist, timeout, and resource binding. IntentFence never fetches or pays the target.
examples: Check that this exact x402 quote is canonical Base USDC, at most 0.10 USDC, pays an approved address, and is bound to the requested URL.
